<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v0.36.0-beta -->

## What's Changed
### New Features
* feat: Show aggregated changelog for skipped versions when updating by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/70
### Bug Fixes
* fix: Prevent caching failed substream probes and simplify camera cards by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/71
* fix: Use browser.devices for pychromecast CastInfo objects by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/72
* fix: Chromecast casting and receiver layout fixes by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/73
* fix: Revert hwdownload optimization for VAAPI multi-output by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/74


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/compare/v0.35.1-beta...v0.36.0-beta

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v0.35.1-beta -->

## What's Changed
### Bug Fixes
* fix: Probe substream during camera startup to show correct resolution by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/66
* fix: Persist settings tab across component remounts during updates by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/67
* fix: Increase icon size inside IconButton for better visibility by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/69
### Other Changes
* refactor: Convert action buttons to icons and add camera status feedback by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/68


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/compare/v0.35.0-beta...v0.35.1-beta
